privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Jameye collects through this website (jameye.com), why we collect it, and the choices you have. It covers the marketing site and waitlist only; the product app has its own terms.

sections.p: When you join the waitlist we collect your email address (required) and, optionally, a nickname/handle, a referral nickname, and an avatar choice. If you leave the nickname blank, one is generated for you.
We use your information to manage the waitlist, prevent duplicate signups, operate the referral leaderboard, and contact you about the launch. We do not sell your personal data.
Your chosen nickname and avatar, along with referral points, are shown publicly on our leaderboard. Your email address is never shown publicly.

Loading the site sends your IP address to Google Fonts (for web fonts) and to Polymarket (for market preview images). We plan to add analytics and advertising tools (see our Cookie Policy); these run only with your consent.
Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your data, and to withdraw consent. To make a request, contact us using the details below.
Questions about this policy or your data? Email us at privacy@jameye.com. (Placeholder address — confirm before launch.)

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Jameye uses cookies and similar technologies on this website, and how you can control them.

sections.p: Today the site sets no analytics or advertising cookies. The only cookie we store is the one that remembers your cookie choices (so we don't ask again on every visit). It is strictly necessary and set without consent.
We intend to introduce Google Analytics 4 (analytics), Google Ads, and X, TikTok and Reddit advertising pixels (marketing). These set cookies and will only run after you accept them.

Strictly necessary — required for the site and login to work; always on. Analytics — help us understand site usage. Marketing — measure and personalize our ads. You can accept or reject the non-essential categories at any time.
You can change your consent at any time using the button below. In the EU/UK, non-essential cookies are only set after you opt in.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of the Jameye website and waitlist. By using the site you agree to them.

sections.p: Joining the waitlist registers your interest in Jameye. It does not guarantee access, a spot in any tournament, or any prize. Details may change as the product develops.
You may share a referral link. Referral points and leaderboard standings are provided for engagement and may be adjusted or reset. We may remove entries that abuse the system (e.g. fake signups).

Any prize pool, figures, or tournament features described on this site are promotional and pre-launch. They are not an offer and are subject to change, eligibility rules, and final terms published at launch.
Don't misuse the site: no automated scraping, no attempts to break or overload it, no impersonation, and no unlawful or abusive content in nicknames or referrals.
The Jameye name, logo, and site content are owned by Jameye and may not be used without permission.
The site is provided "as is" without warranties. Governing law and full terms will be finalized before launch. Questions? Email legal@jameye.com. (Placeholder address — confirm before launch.)
